name: Large Pitchable Propeller
description: A standard number input controls the propeller's hub, allowing you to affect its pitch. Power received from an engine affects forward and backward force generated. This propeller will only operate underwater.
shortDescription: A large boat propeller with controllable pitch.

logicNodes.label: Pitch
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch amount.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: Receives power generated by an engine.
